classification.difficultyReason: Construct and interpret a journey graph, write a formula, and compare arrival time with sunset.

content.prompt: A man is walking to a town at 6.5 km/h. He starts at a point 20 km from the town.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a graph of distance travelled against time taken.

answer.short: Straight-line segment from $(0,0)$ to $\left(\frac{40}{13},20\right)$, with time in hours and distance travelled in kilometres.
answer.worked: The distance travelled starts at 0 and increases at 6.5 km/h. The journey lasts $20\div6.5=\frac{40}{13}$ hours. Plot $(0,0)$ and $\left(\frac{40}{13},20\right)$ and join them with a straight line.

spec.description: Graph answering the printed distance-travelled wording; this differs from the answer book’s distance-remaining graph.
spec.answerVisibility: Solution only; unresolved source/answer conflict is recorded separately.

children.label: b
children.prompt: State the gradient and vertical axis intercept.

answer.worked: Distance travelled increases by 6.5 km each hour, giving gradient 6.5. At the start, distance travelled is 0, giving vertical intercept 0.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Give a formula for the distance travelled $d$ km after $t$ hours.

answer.worked: Distance travelled equals speed multiplied by time, so $d=6.5t$. The journey ends after $\frac{40}{13}$ hours.

children.label: d
children.prompt: If the man starts walking at 3 p.m. and sunset is at 5:45 p.m., will he arrive during daylight?

answer.short: No. He arrives at approximately 6:05 p.m.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Journey time}&=\frac{20}{6.5}\\\text{Journey time}&=\frac{40}{13}\text{ h}\\\text{Journey time}&=3\text{ h }4\frac8{13}\text{ min}\end{align*}$$
Starting at 3 p.m., he arrives at approximately 6:05 p.m., after the 5:45 p.m. sunset.
